meta.title: IPFS Attest Hubzilla Post
meta.purpose: Prepare an authenticated user's own Hubzilla post as an attestation package, then publish, pin, and POSIX-map it through the controlled IPFS/orchestrator backend.

objects.label: Profile boundary
objects.default: This Webform selects a Hubzilla-known orchestrator service profile. The certified JSON names the profile and backend role; the Hubzilla node resolves the actual local endpoint. No raw Kubo URL, git write path, or service secret is portable package data.

objects.label: Verification boundary
objects.default: Verify Profile checks that the selected profile resolves to orchestrator1 and matches backend role ipfs_publication. It does not publish, pin, unpin, write git/POSIX paths, expose credentials, or call raw Kubo RPC from the browser.

objects.label: Profile status
objects.default:
Connection status: not checked
Capability status: available
Execution active: false
Backend role: ipfs_publication
Authority boundary safe: not checked

objects.label: Profile fields
objects.default:
service_pack: ipfs
profile_id: ipfs-publication-default
target: orchestrator1
orchestrator: orchestrator1.internal.diagnostics.kane-il.us
backend_role: ipfs_publication
backend_node: ipfs1.diagnostics.kane-il.us
raw_kubo_rpc_exposed: false
raw_git_write_exposed: false
status: available

objects.label: Operation list
objects.default:
operations:
ipfs.cid.prepare
ipfs.cid.publish
ipfs.cid.pin
ipfs.cid.request_unpin
git_posix.path_reference.create
ipfs.cid.read_verify

Attestation operations required next:
hubzilla.own_post.resolve
attestation.package.prepare

objects.label: Own post selector
objects.default: Future picker: authenticated user's own Hubzilla posts with delivery manifests. The user should select an authored post from the local node, not paste someone else's post or an external archive target.

objects.label: Selection rule
objects.default: This workflow is for an authenticated user's own Hubzilla post. A post by someone else is archival/evidence capture, not this attestation workflow.

objects.label: Resolver work for orchestrator/API
objects.default:
Required resolver contract:
1. Receive selected local post reference from Webforms/Hubzilla.
2. Confirm the post belongs to the authenticated channel owner.
3. Produce the Hubzilla/Nomad JSON payload or a precise failure status.
4. Return stable identifiers and hashes for review.

objects.label: Resolved payload fields
objects.default: item_id | mid | guid | object_id | canonical_url | author_channel | created | edited | delivery_manifest | payload_sha256 | payload_size_bytes | retrieval_status

objects.label: Evidence context
objects.placeholder: Brief account/context for why this authored post is being preserved as attestation

objects.label: Attestation package preview
objects.default:
source: local Hubzilla post
retrieval: local_hubzilla_source
payload: Nomad/Zot6 JSON
verification: owner post confirmed / signatures not yet checked
publication: pending

objects.label: Work for IPFS/Kubo/orchestrator
objects.default:
Required operation chain after attestation review:
1. attestation.package.prepare
2. ipfs.cid.publish
3. ipfs.cid.pin
4. git_posix.path_reference.create
5. ipfs.cid.read_verify
No raw Kubo RPC, git write path, service credential, or pinset mutation authority is exposed to Webforms.

notes: This addon-bundled package is declarative only.
This workflow is for an authenticated user's own Hubzilla post, not archival capture of someone else's post.
The local Hubzilla node should be the primary source for resolving the post payload.
The delivery manifest is selection/distribution evidence, not the primary source of the payload.
No Kubo RPC, git/POSIX write, credential use, service call, server write, database write, or federation action is performed by this package.
The package targets orchestrator1 conceptually; raw endpoint URLs and mutation authority are not embedded in portable JSON.
